summary.oneLiner: A fully integrated home-textile manufacturer producing curtain and upholstery fabrics, readymade curtains and fabric-processing (job-work) services, selling under own brands and on private/white-label basis.
summary.business: Harit Industries Limited operates as a fully integrated textile manufacturing entity in the Home Textile Sector, managing the entire value chain in-house from design to weaving, processing and finishing. It runs three core divisions - fabrics for curtains and upholstery, fabric processing on a job-work basis (primarily dyeing, plus embroidery and weaving), and readymade curtains - across economy and premium price points. Customers are wholesalers, retailers and corporate customers for the curtain/fabric divisions and textile manufacturers for the job-work division; through its Subsidiaries …
